DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http://wvvw.dilq.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 73 s. 2021 02 June 2021 HON. RYANH M. DOLOR Mayor Bauan, Batangas Dear Mayor Dolor: This has reference to your letter dated IO November 2020, requesting for this Department's opinion on whether the proposed elevated structure would fall within the meaning of road obstruction. Per your letter, the local govemment of Bauan conducted a widespread road clearing including its public market. Among the affected thereof were some of the vendors located at Buendia St. of your municipality. To address the problem, you came up with a proposal, an elevated structure which will accommodate the displaced vendors and the lower part will remain to be used as a one-way road for private and public vehicles. Hence, your request for this Department's opinion on whether the said proposed elevated structure would fall within the meaning of road obstruction. The Department's view is in the affirmative. The proposed elevated structure falls within the meaning of road obstruction as contemplated in DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2020-027. While Section 21 (d) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) allows the local govemment units to close roads and regulate the use of any local street, road, thoroughfare, or any other public place where shopping malls, Sunday, flea or night markets, or shopping areas may be established and where goods, merchandise, foodstuffs, commodities, or articles of

commerce may be sold and dispensed to the general public, the same pertains to temporary closure. It must be noted that the proposed elevated structure is a permanent structure. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, B the Authority of the Secretary: NGAN Unders cretary for Local Govemment LS/90 Copy fumished: Regional Director Ariel O. Iglesia DILG Region IV-A CALABARZON 3/F Andenson Bldg. 1, National Highway Brgy. Parian, City of Calamba, Laguna
